reasoning: New trading command with server-side state management and real-time monitoring. Follows existing command patterns (similar to trailing stop) but requires cross-cutting changes across client, server, and shared modules. No external integrations needed - uses existing Bybit WebSocket for trade monitoring.

scope.notes: Changes span client (app.rs, ui.rs), server (client_handler.rs, server.rs), and shared (messages.rs, types.rs). Timer indicator requires UI changes in trades tape.

integrations.notes: Uses existing Bybit WebSocket trade stream (publicTrade topic). No new APIs or dependencies required.

infrastructure.notes: Server-side state management for active panic stops is ephemeral (in-memory). No persistent storage needed.

knowledge.notes: Codebase already has: pipe command pattern (PendingAction), server command handlers (client_handler.rs), WebSocket trade streaming (WsEvent::TradeUpdate), and timer patterns in tokio. TrailingStop is similar reference implementation.

concerns: Race conditions between trade updates and timer expiry
Market order execution during high volatility
risk.notes: Trading execution logic requires careful error handling. Position exit at market is irreversible action.

validation_recommendations.reasoning: Trading command with market execution requires unit tests for timer logic, state management, and command parsing. Integration tests needed for client-server message flow. No security scan needed as no auth/credential changes. No staging deployment required - testnet mode already available via BYBIT_TESTNET env var.

key_patterns_to_follow: TrailingStopRequest/SetTrailingStop flow for client→server command pattern
files_to_study: client/src/app.rs - command parsing and pipe logic
suggested_new_types: PanicStopState { symbol, side, started_at, last_trade_at, trigger_price }
